# NodeAccessibility

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Accessibility facts captured for a layout node, mirroring what the tagging pipeline would write into the PDF structure tree for the same element. Present only when the element exposes a role (implements `IRoleProvider`); geometry-only nodes (bare containers, pages) omit it.

These are the element's *intrinsic* semantics, read directly off the element — they do not depend on `AccessibilityMode` being enabled, so the compliance evaluator can answer "would this be accessible?" even for untagged documents.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`alt`](#alt): `/Alt` alternate text, when the element supplies non-empty alt text.
- [`artifact`](#artifact): True when the element renders as an `/Artifact` (out of reading order).
- [`decorative`](#decorative): Author explicitly marked the element decorative (artifact by intent).
- [`headingLevel`](#headinglevel): Heading level 1–6 for `H1`…`H6` roles; omitted otherwise.
- [`imageLike`](#imagelike): True when the element is image-like (a figure candidate): an Image, QR code, barcode, data matrix, or canvas drawing.
- [`role`](#role): Resolved PDF structure tag, e.g. `"H1"`, `"P"`, `"Figure"`, `"TH"`.
- [`tagged`](#tagged): True when the element contributes real content to the structure tree.

### `imageLike`

```typescript
imageLike?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

True when the element is image-like (a figure candidate): an Image, QR code, barcode, data matrix, or canvas drawing. Lets the evaluator flag image-like content that fell back to `/Artifact` for want of alt text — a case external validators pass silently.

### `role`

Resolved PDF structure tag, e.g. `"H1"`, `"P"`, `"Figure"`, `"TH"`.

### `tagged`


True when the element contributes real content to the structure tree.
